''1ˢᵗ – 2ⁿᵈ '' - BiscuitTurtleKid & ThamnosThirio |difficulty = Normal |length_measurement = 01:00.52 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A rather deformed area filled with discomfort.|Your_Adversary on X|https://x.com/Your_Adv/status/1648252745370025985}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Nether''' is a hell-like [[Maps|map]]. It is assumed that this is the underworld, popular in religious cultures. What hell is depicted as by '''Nether''' has changed over time, with remakes to the map. This map is included in the map rotation for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, as well as the regular map rotation for normal gameplay. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Nether''' has four reddish-brown islands with black rocks in a magma pool. Various tusks and smaller magma pools can be seen. Several tall black fortress like buildings can be seen in a gothic style. The entire map is surrounded by magma. The reddish-brown path begins and ends at two caves. It crosses all four islands with stone bridges linking the islands. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Nether''' was identical to the first version, except that the skybox changed, and the tone of the map was changed to be darker. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Nether''' had a magma theme, with several volcanoes and magma pools dotted around the map. The map itself consisted of two islands connected by a bridge, which was also part of the path. The entire map was surrounded by a black void. The islands themselves were chained to more solid structures sticking from out of the void. This gave the illusion that the islands were floating. The black stone path began and ended at two lava portals at opposite ends of the map. It is relatively straight, though there are two kinks in the path to take a random detour. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Nether}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *Cliff spots are quite spaced out in this map. **Aside from a small mound found on the third island, all the cliff spots are to the side of the path, away from optimal positions. *Long-ranged towers, such as the [[Turret]], are recommended on this map to exploit the high number of turns. **The [[DJ Booth]] can help increase the range of towers. *The [[Military Base]] units can help on this map if enemies get past your main defenses. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} Nether.png|First version (24 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) NetherIcon.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|View}} Neth.png|First version (24 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) NView.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} HiddenBossStrangledUpdateIcon.png|First version on the game icon. IconWithText.png|First version on the game thumbnail. IconE.png|First version on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} OldNetherDI1.png|First version on a development image. OldNetherDI2.png|First version on a development image. OldNetherDI3.jpg|First version on a development image. OldNetherDI4.png|First version on a development image. Ghost DJ Booth Teaser|Current version on a development video. NetherDI1.png|Unreleased version on a development image. NetherDI2.png|Unreleased version on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} File:Commander_gives_his_thoughts_on_the_skill_tree }} ==Trivia== *This map is an obvious reference to ''Minecraft's'' [https://minecraft.wiki/w/The_Nether Nether] dimension. *You can place ground towers underneath the map. *On the original two version of '''Nether''', there were various Robloxians scattered across the map. **One of Robloxians had a sign saying "''Ah those poor souls...''" above its head. *While this map was remade in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], it was not massively overhauled like other maps. **The biggest change was the change in skybox and the removal of skulls on sticks across the map. **This map was later completely overhauled in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. ==Update History== *'''24 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.2|BETA v1.2.0]] **'''Nether''' added. *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **{{Color|OldNormal}} difficulty removed. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Nether''' remade. **{{Bug}} '''Nether''' skybox is broken. *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Nether''' skybox was fixed. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Nether''' remade. **Made playable on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **{{Color|Normal}} difficulty added. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **No longer playable in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Notes== {{MapNavBox}}
